To get access to the reporting workspace, ask for access through the service desk form "Reporting workspace access", naming the business unit and the reports needed. Your line manager approves; access is usually granted within two working days.

## Details

1. Open the service desk form "Reporting workspace access" [HOW-0001].
2. Choose the business unit and list the reports you need [HOW-0001].
3. Your line manager receives the approval request [HOW-0001].

- [HOW-0001] Request access to the reporting workspace, Verified: 2026-06-15 by Data platform lead.
- The access procedure page, June 2026 [HOW-0001].

Note: If you need access to the reporting workspace, please submit a request through the service desk form "Reporting workspace access" and follow the steps outlined in HOW-0001. If you have any questions or concerns, you can reach out to the Data platform lead.
